notes.title: Virtual Axe Throwing is Coming!
notes.content:
Virtual Axe Throwing!

The world around your arcade is growing! Real world axe-throwing pioneers, BATL, have moved into the neighbourhood and are open for business! Thanks to the success of your arcade, the area around your venue is beginning to attract top entertainment brands.

Now it’s up to you to unleash your inner lumberjack! Grab some friends and venture out into the street to explore the neighbourhood where you'll find BATL Axe Throwing, the real-life axe throwing chain, and inventors of the sport! Select from a variety of axes, step up to the line and throw, savoring the resounding thud of steel embedding into the timber target.

Here's what's you can expect in axe throwing:


 Play solo or with up to 4 people in multiplayer.
 Standard axes available to use immediately.
 Ten incredibly weird and wonderful axes have been added to your prize store.
 Traditional axe throwing lanes and a super-sized axe throwing gallery.
 Get big discounts in-game to use at real-world BATL locations for axe throwing IRL!
 Enjoy a soundscape that any urban lumberjack is sure to love!


Classic axe throwing games mixed with new arcadified formats:


 Standard BATL – High score competition on official IATF Targets.
 Classic Target – Smaller scoring rings with more point variations.
 Tic-Tac-Toe – The classic head-to-head game puts accuracy to the test!
 Bullseye Blitz – A giant bullseye that increases in value but shrinks in size with each hit!
 Ultra BATL – Get ready... this target is larger-than-life!


10 incredible axes to redeem with tickets in your prize store!

Laugh with friends, make some new ones, and compete for top scores and bragging rights! Let the axe-citement begin!

About BATL Axe Throwing

BATL founded the sport of urban axe throwing in 2006 as The Backyard Axe Throwing League, and are a proud founding member of the International Axe Throwing Federation (IATF), the sport's official governing body.  Now simply known as BATL Axe Throwing, they have 17 locations across the U.S. and Canada, with more coming in the future!  Want to go axe throwing IRL?  There might be a BATL location near you - check them out at www.batlgrounds.com

You can book a real axe throwing session using BATLARCADE10 at checkout for 10% off!  We'd love to see your adventures, make sure to use #BATLVR when you share your photos and stories!

notes.title: Updates and Changelog - June 15
notes.content:
Arcade Legend's Road to Next Fest 2021!

Things have been moving fast and furious inside the arcade over the last 2 months.  We ran a private closed beta test and got some incredible feedback before allowing some of our Discord community exclusive access to a build of our pre-Next Fest demo.  They gave us even more valuable feedback, and we've reworked entire systems within the arcade to deliver the best version of our game demo for Next Fest. Now we're ready to reveal Arcade Legend to the world!  Join our growing Discord community to talk to other players, and tell us what you think of the game!

There is so much more to come, but here is what we've been working on over the last month.

Next Fest Changelog

 Improved visuals of game cabinets
 Add voice overs with instructions on cleaning rubbish

 Add option to turn subtitles off

 Add functionality to decorator mode to click and drag to apply materials

 Add End Turn button functionality on Let’s Bounce
 Improved physical interactions with the powerglove menu buttons

Closed Private Beta
